rule: Owner, 2026-10-25: a character who appears once looks the same in every later video (Moses after 100 videos is the same Moses). Every prompt that shows a character carries its `look` word for word (plus one `wardrobe` variant), Agnes clips pass its approved reference images (reference mode, up to 5), and FLUX stills reuse its seed. A character is used only when its status is APPROVED (Claude reviewed the reference sheet). God the Father is never shown as a person: light, wind, voice (reverence; the KJV text carries Him).

noah.name: Noah
noah.look: a strong broad-shouldered elderly man of about seventy with Middle Eastern features, weathered olive skin, a long grey beard, short grey hair on a bare head, deep-set dark eyes under heavy brows, a plain brown wool robe belted with a rope

wardrobe.before-the-flood: standing alone on a dry hillside at dusk, his hands empty at his sides
wardrobe.builder: his sleeves rolled to the elbow, sawdust on his robe, a wooden mallet in one hand
wardrobe.ark: standing in the open doorway of a vast wooden ark under a grey sky

noah.note: Genesis 7:6 makes him six hundred years old at the flood; shown as a strong elderly man of about seventy (owner, 2026-10-26). A bare head, a grey (not silver-white) beard and a belted plain robe keep him apart from the Keeper's hood and silver beard.
